# AML-Filter

> AML-Filter is a zero-server engineering demonstration for screening names against signed sanctions data in a web browser.

AML-Filter runs its screening and local review workflow in the browser. It has no account system or application backend. It is not legal advice and not a compliance product; do not use it to satisfy legal or regulatory obligations.

Source repository: currently private. The public site does not claim that its implementation or internal documentation is publicly accessible.

## Primary links

- [AML-Filter](https://aml-filter.com/): Product overview and scope.
- [Screen a name](https://aml-filter.com/screen): Interactive in-browser screening demo.
- [Sitemap](https://aml-filter.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages.
